claims.text: SPS at 1050 °C for 10 minutes followed by cooling will precipitate a tetragonal σ-phase in Al-Cr-Fe-Mn-Ti.
The proposed processing route will refine the BCC/B2 matrix.
σ-phase precipitation and finer phase distribution will increase hardness relative to an arc-melted alloy.
SPS consolidation will produce a density approaching the theoretical density.
The Al-Cr-Fe-Mn-Ti system contains computationally screened candidate compositions with melting temperatures above 1250 °C and selected BCC/L21 phase fractions.
Inert-gas atomization can suppress segregation and produce a finer initial phase distribution than arc melting.
SPS at 1050 °C for 10 minutes with passive cooling is a demonstrated processing condition for σ-phase formation.
A processing temperature of 1050 °C is above the L21 order-disorder transition in the proposed Al-Cr-Fe-Mn-Ti alloy.
The SPS process will generate a high density of grain boundaries in the proposed alloy.
A high density of grain boundaries provides short-circuit diffusion paths for Cr ions to reach the surface.
Rapid Cr transport through grain boundaries facilitates formation of a continuous protective Cr2O3 scale.
A continuous Cr2O3 scale suppresses high-temperature oxidation kinetics.
The processed alloy will show a 30–50% reduction in oxidation kinetics at 850–1050 °C relative to coarse-grained as-cast material.
Arc-melted Al-Cr-Fe-Mn-Ti has a coarse-grained microstructure that lacks σ-phase.
Slow Cr diffusion in coarse-grained as-cast material leads to a non-protective spinel oxide.
Retention of σ-phase requires processing below its composition-dependent solvus and a cooling schedule that avoids dissolution or coarsening.
Oxidation protection requires enough Cr to form a continuous chromia layer.
Excessive partitioning of Cr into σ-phase may prevent formation of a continuous chromia layer.
A grain size that is too large may prevent sufficiently rapid Cr transport for protective-scale formation.
The exact σ-phase solvus and its interaction with L21 stability are not established for the proposed quinary composition.

contradictions.description: The cooling treatment is described variously as a controlled or specific cooling rate, passive cooling followed by a specific cooling rate, and simply passive cooling to room temperature. These do not define one internally consistent cooling schedule.
